name: LeakCheck public API (breach source names and field names per e-mail or username)
operator: LeakCheck (leakcheck.io; the operating entity is not named on the public API pages)
tier_rationale: Identifiable breach-search service with public API documentation and a track record, but no terms page reachable on 2026-11-26 (P135 chair: 'Tier community (identifiable operator without published terms)').

reliability.justification: Aggregator of breach corpora and combolists: source names and month dates per value, data-class names as a union over all sources (no per-source classes); generic and shared values return hundreds of sources (test@example.com -> found 1715), so found >= 100 is flagged generic (P135 cond 5).

error_markers.reason: LeakCheck: public API limit reached ('limit' error inside a 200 answer): provider stopped for today (could not verify)
LeakCheck: public API throttled (HTTP 429): provider stopped for today (could not verify)

public.title: LeakCheck public API GET /api/public?check=<e-mail or username>: found count, source names and month dates, data-class (field) NAMES only

terms.quote: Terms 'unknown' (A1 BR16; no terms page reachable on 2026-11-26): disabled in every profile until legal records LeakCheck's terms.

sanitizer.notes: P135 cond 4 / P145: only the found count, the field NAMES (data classes, never values), the source names with their month dates and the error text survive before the HTTP cache; any other or future field is dropped.

public.notes: A1 initial class: LeakCheck public = 'unknown' (P135 cond 1): disabled in every licence profile until legal records the terms. osint_investigator's evidence (LeakCheck API docs, checked 2026-11-26: the Public API is 'Free, including commercial use' with a 'Powered by LeakCheck' link) is queued for that review (P135 cond 2); if cleared the class becomes open with the attribution 'Powered by LeakCheck' in the report footer and v3lum info. URL allow-list: only GET https://leakcheck.io/api/public?check=<value> (P135 cond 3); the authenticated v2 'lookup' API (raw records with passwords) is never implemented or subscribed to. Documented 1 request/s (min_interval 1 s); 429 and 'limit' bodies stop the provider for the UTC day (markers above, P135 cond 6). Research C0304 (verified_live 200). Used by leakcheck_public.
public.licensed_alternative: Have I Been Pwned breachedaccount (hibp.account, company subscription) and XposedOrNot xonAPI+ give per-address breach names under a recorded licence.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G04-1 (P135 leakcheck_public). Sensitive provider (A4): the sanitizer schema applies before the HTTP cache (sanitized payload, TTL <= 7 days); the module keeps field names as data classes, never values. Tier community; terms unknown (default_enabled False, A3 BR2).
